✓ Mercy dog.fact: A mercy dog (also called an ambulance dog, Red Cross dog, or casualty dog) was a dog that served in a paramedical role in the military, most notably during World War I. They were often sent out after large battles, where they would seek out wounded soldiers, and they were well-suited to the conditions of trench warfare. Many mercy dogs were trained by national Red Cross societies to serve the country in which the specific society operated.
